description: Source code for the LP50xx LED controller driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, and control functions for LED modules.

methods.name: lp50xx_led_to_info
methods.description: Converts LED index to led_info structure pointer based on configuration.

methods.name: lp50xx_get_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific LED.

methods.name: lp50xx_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of a specific LED.

methods.name: lp50xx_on
methods.description: Turns on a specific LED by setting brightness to maximum.

methods.name: lp50xx_off
methods.description: Turns off a specific LED by setting brightness to zero.

methods.name: lp50xx_set_color
methods.description: Sets the color of a specific LED with RGB values.

methods.name: lp50xx_write_channels
methods.description: Writes brightness or color data to multiple channels starting at a specified channel.

methods.name: lp50xx_reset
methods.description: Performs a software reset of the device.

methods.name: lp50xx_hw_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables hardware via GPIO.

methods.name: lp50xx_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the device via I2C register.

methods.name: lp50xx_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, configures GPIO, resets, and enables hardware.
